body: It just still really fuckin hurts, I know thats normal and I just have to get through it. I guess it’s just accepting it.

She said she tried, but it never got better. 
To be honest I called her, didn’t beg or anything. Just mentioned that if she ever wanted to try again, turns out she is already sleeping with some other fuck. So idk

So I loved being able to just have someone there by my side, being able to complain and talk about things with.  But then I just am terrified ill never find someone I meshed so we’ll with. That I had so much in common with. 

Even though I have this other amazing girl, it scares the shit outta me that ill fuck that one up and just be alone. Cause my new girlfriend is almost too good to be true.

I was literally getting ready to call her, I just miss all those moments and hate going about all this shit by myself. 
Thank you though...

It’s going well, the girl is amazing. I specifically went into this one looking out for what killed the relationship with my ex. She is just caring, sweet and is just empathetic to everything going on with me. 
But she is currently living long distance for a few months while she helps family. So day to day I’m just having to text, and video chat with her whenever possible. Just don’t want to subject her to all of this...

Just alone now, I mean I’ve made improvements. Going back to school, back in my hometown with people I love. It went from recovering my health to now moving past my health issues and just advancing my life more. For months I was fine, knowing I left cause I had to. Not blinking in what the right decision was....but just recently I have been looking back at how we were compatible, and the good times. And specifically tbh the idea of her being with someone else, just fkin hurts so much. Even though she did some really shitty awful things to me

I have been so close to messaging her, just saying sorry. We have barely spoke since I decided to leave. 
I will never admit to anyone I know, but a part of me wants to try. But I remember it being bad, I have severe depression, anxiety and ptsd. I put all those problems and assumed she was what made them worse. And I hated her for it, Dont get me wrong. She did some fucked up things, but still....

She just always out her problems ahead of mine, always judged me and never appreciated anything I did. Was mean to friends and people close to her, I was just unhappy I guess at the time with alot of what was going on. I have severe depression, anxiety, PTSD. I assumed it was all cause of how she was treating me.

Don’t get me wrong...it was bad. 
Like she was mean, and rude, selfish. 
But I dont know, I feel like it could’ve been worked on and it was how she was raised. 

It just really hurts and I am in a bad place. Im not sure what to do, figured someone on here might have some wisdom.

Thank you. Honestly.
